_about: Ethanol (1) + Toluene (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: R. Chen, L. Zhong, C. Xu, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium for Binary Systems  of Toluene + Ethanol, Toluene + Isopropanol at (101.3,  121.3, 161.3 and 201.3) kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 155-165
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 4. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.21 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
